body:
BASED OFF PERCY JACKSON :)


Suggestion for a game. Gamemode Avicade.


Every is on a horse. There are (number) kits. Every player chooses one. The kits can give potions, weapons, etc. there will be a race track and the player must pass the finish line 2x to win. Also, there will be traps scattered around the track. Pvp is enabled and u can attack horses BUT the horse will have unlimited health.
